change: Reuse each row ID and quantized gradient across four adjacent dense ELLPACK feature histograms. Exact integer accumulation and dequantization are unchanged. Binary-feature, sparse, small and oversized shared-memory cases retain existing paths.

measurement.timing: Fresh worker processes with isolated baseline/candidate packages. Warm runtime; xgb.train includes quantization and held-out evaluation. Loading, DMatrix setup and final prediction reported separately. Runs sequential, no concurrent assistant builds/tests/benchmarks.
measurement.command_template: .venv/bin/python scripts/profile_training.py --case CASE --output EXISTING_NEW_WORKER_DIRECTORY --rounds 100 --threads 8 --worker cpu|mps --repeat-index 0|1|2 --package-dir ISOLATED_PACKAGE; wide additionally uses --rows 1000000 --features 128
measurement.counter_note: gpu_time_ns is histogram GPU time. GPU family counters may overlap; do not sum or subtract them from wall time to infer CPU overhead.

correctness.final_native_result: 316 cases, 72700780 exact fields; rerun after strengthening six shared-path assertions. Production kernel/library unchanged.
correctness.large_outputs: Actual model bytes and all held-out margin arrays match exactly across six MPS workers per dataset. Each MPS worker also checks identical CPU prediction of its saved model. Independent CPU/MPS training differs as reported; no NVIDIA execution.

installed_package.isolation: python -I; cwd outside checkout; no PYTHONPATH or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH; pytest pythonpath override empty

limitations: One M3; all controlled runs on AC power. User applications remained open, system-wide swap was 21608-23944 MB, and CPU/wall timings varied. This is not a thermally isolated machine or a hardware-only limit.

Histogram timing improved in every pair, supporting the bounded optimization. Ratio of training medians is 1.45 wide / 1.08 HIGGS; median paired training ratios are 1.21 / 1.06. These are different summaries of three variable repeats, not guaranteed gains.
CPU median training remains faster than optimized MPS on both workloads. Exploratory runs precede controlled pairs and are not used for headline speedup claims.
Full row counts with 100 rounds, not a rerun of the historical 1000-round HIGGS benchmark. Cold runtime compilation and sparse/high-cardinality performance are outside this experiment.

Full standard suite passed before optimization; final acceptance is focused native/Python, installed workflows and large output equivalence. Other Apple GPUs, NVIDIA runtime and multi-host configurations were not tested.
